name: Modified
source:
A story related to Lucius...
Centuries have passed since the crucifixion of Jesus; as well as the conversion of the demon Lucius to the holy path...
Wander is a descendant of Lucius - a demon - who looks for a way to prove his value.
During his journey - someone started to murder cultists who tries to take the control of the country...
translation:
与卢修斯有关的故事……
自从耶稣被钉十字架以来，已经过去了几个世纪。以及恶魔卢修斯皈依圣道……
旺德是恶魔卢修斯的后裔，他正在寻找一种方法来证明自己的价值。
在他的旅程中，有人开始谋杀试图控制国家的邪教徒……
